featured_reviews.name: Harikrishna kava
featured_reviews.review_text:
5/5 – Spacious, well-maintained government auditorium with great value

I recently booked this government auditorium for a large event and was really impressed with the overall experience. The hall is huge, with a seating capacity of more than 1,200 people, and it didn’t feel cramped at all even with a full house. There’s plenty of space for stage setup, seating arrangements, and movement around the venue.

What makes this place stand out is the value for money. For a government facility, the booking price is very reasonable compared to private halls of this size. Despite the low cost, the maintenance is excellent. The interiors are clean, the seating is in good condition, and the overall upkeep shows that it’s well taken care of.

The AC works really well and kept the entire hall comfortably cool throughout the event, which is a big deal for large gatherings. The sound system is also top-notch – clear audio, no echo or distortion, and the staff helped us set it up smoothly. Lighting is adequate for both stage performances and presentations.

Location is easy to find and parking was manageable for our guests. The caretaker and support staff were cooperative and responsive whenever we needed help during setup.

For anyone looking for a large, affordable, and reliable venue for conferences, cultural programs, or community events, this auditorium is a solid choice. You get professional-grade facilities without the high private-venue price tag.

Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Lata Mangeshkar Auditorium in Mira Road to watch a Marathi play. The auditorium is very well maintained and clean. The interiors are beautifully designed and feature memories and tributes to Late Shri Lata Mangeshkar Ji, which gives the place a special touch.
The washrooms were clean, and there are water filters available as well. For food, they have limited options like popcorn, samosa, sandwiches, though the menu may vary depending on the event.
The seating was comfortable, and the management team was cooperative and helpful. The auditorium is fully air-conditioned, but during our visit, the cooling felt a bit low, and it was slightly hot inside.
Outside food items and water bottles are not allowed inside the auditorium. Overall, it is a good auditorium in Mira Road, clean and well maintained, with decent facilities. The only thing I feel is that there should be more plays, concerts, and events happening here because it is a great venue that deserves more activity.

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Khambhayata
featured_reviews.review_text:
Perfect place for art, drama & show performance. Hall are well maintained with cleanliness & Comfortable seats.Late Legend Lata Mangeshkar photographs, artwork and Some vintage bollywood posters at entry adding more charm to ambience, Which also recalls golden era of Bollywood and Indian cinema.

Most Important: If you are choosing uppar seats then try to avoid starting 3 rows of upper seats because Safety relling may irritate your view during stage show, Rest all things are perfect for beautiful show experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved my visit to Bharat Ratna Gaansamragyi Lata Mangeshkar Auditorium!  From the moment you step in, the architecture and interior beautifully celebrate the legacy of the legendary Lata Mangeshkar. The venue is spacious, clean, and thoughtfully designed — perfect for concerts, theatre shows, cultural events, and school functions alike. The ambience truly reflects India’s rich musical heritage, and the experience was enjoyable for all ages. The parking and lift facilities add extra convenience, especially for senior visitors. Highly recommend this cultural gem in Mira Road East to anyone looking for a wonderful and memorable event venue!

featured_reviews.name: Subhojit Chandra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this auditorium for my daughter's school annual function.

While it is easily accessible due to the location near to the highway, rickshaws to come towards Bhayander are available from the other side only. The highway is dangerous to cross due the speeding vehicles.

Eatables are not allowed inside the auditorium stating that everything is available, but there is just one stall limiting options. The stall was selling cold burgers, cold paneer sandwiches at insane price tag.

There were technical glitches during some performances where audio went mute. Considering the event, it would have been better if the staff had conducted audits prior to the event.The downtime was around 10 minutes but could have been avoided.

Seating arrangements within the auditorium is comfortable but confirm the seat numbers properly. The first row of seats is for VIP guests. Row A is the second row and so on. We were seated in row J but our invitation card showed row K, due to this confusion.

featured_reviews.review_text: The auditorium was fantastic, with statues and historical insights into our old film industry were truly remarkable. A definite must-visit! ✨🎬

featured_reviews.name: kajol patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited GST, and while the overall vibe of the place was good, our experience was a bit disappointing. Upon receiving the menu, we discovered that it is a vegetarian restaurant, which was fine, but to our surprise, they do serve liquor. This initially seemed like a great option for those looking to enjoy a drink alongside their meal.

However, when we decided to order starters, we were informed that the kitchen was not operational at that time. This left us puzzled, as we couldn’t understand why the restaurant would open its doors solely for drinks and not offer food. The menu was also quite limited, which further contributed to our confusion. Since we weren’t able to order anything from the food menu, we didn’t get the chance to evaluate the quality or variety of the dishes.

On a positive note, the ambiance of GST was quite pleasant. The music was well-chosen, and the atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, making it a good spot for a casual hangout or drink. Unfortunately, our visit didn’t allow us to fully experience the restaurant as we had hoped, but if you’re looking for a place to enjoy drinks and a lively atmosphere, GST might still be worth checking out, provided the kitchen is functioning.
